dogecoin.text: @heydave7 @elonmusk @dogecoin_devs I think it started as a joke, but then he became the Doge whale thinking there is a sizable chance he can use the current liquidity / hype cycle to ensure the Mars mission is funded. He sees the moral risk of pumping a s-coin and mitigating it by getting devs to improve the coin.

@coinbase @dogecoin My take on Dogecoin is that the community is more important than the technology. The coin is code and code is meant to be continuously improved. I initially dismissed Doge based on its code, but I became a believer based on its community.
